I’d combine B and A.

When saving, I want the editable preview from B so I can correct the title or description before confirming it. Afterward, I prefer the clear Edit button from A; it’s easier to discover and understand than clicking text and saving by clicking away.

To keep routine saves quick, the preview can already be filled in and ready to confirm immediately when everything looks right. Please use that same edit screen later for changing the saved details.
